name: Patient Services – Complete Care Beyond Treatment
headline: Comprehensive Support Services for International Patients in India
intro: We understand that traveling to another country for medical treatment can feel overwhelming. That’s why we provide end-to-end patient support services to make your medical journey in India safe, stress-free, and comfortable. From medical visa assistance to airport pickups, affordable accommodation, and dedicated care coordinators — we take care of everything while you focus on your recovery.

services.title: Medical Visa Assistance & Travel Support
services.description: We guide you through the medical visa application process, provide invitation letters from hospitals, and help you with flight planning and travel arrangements.

services.title: Free Second Opinion & Online Consultations
services.description: Before you travel, you can consult India’s leading doctors online. We provide free medical opinions and treatment plans so you can make informed choices.

services.title: Air Ambulance Services
services.description: For critically ill patients, we arrange emergency air ambulance transfers to India with medical staff on board.

services.title: Airport Pickup & Ground Transfers
services.description: From the moment you land, we ensure safe and comfortable transfers between the airport, hotel, and hospital.

services.title: Stay & Accommodation Near Hospitals
services.description: We help you book budget hotels, serviced apartments, or guest houses close to the hospital for your convenience.

services.title: Dedicated 24/7 Assistance
services.description: Every patient gets a personal care coordinator to handle hospital formalities, translations, and support during your entire stay.

services.title: Affordable Medical Treatment in India
services.description: We ensure you get the lowest treatment costs with top hospitals, with no hidden fees or overcharging.

services.title: Post-Treatment Recovery & Follow-Up
services.description: Even after your treatment, we provide follow-up consultations with doctors and can connect you to Ayurveda & wellness programs for faster recovery.

whyChooseUs: Partnered with India’s best JCI/NABH hospitals
Transparent cost estimates – no surprise charges
Care in your own language (Arabic, French, Swahili, Bangla & more)
Focus on patient care, not profits

cta.text: Start Your Medical Journey with Confidence
features: Guidance Every Step of the Way
